coastal.title: Wildfires expose accessibility failures: advocates
coastal.description: Janice Lyons was upstairs in her Summerland, B.C., home when there was a flash at her doorbell, which lights up in her Deaf household in place of a chime.

coastal.title: Preschool fire safety lessons put to the test during Summerland evacuation
coastal.description: As Learning Cove Preschool prepares to welcome children back, staff say fire safety lessons taught in the classroom helped prepare students

coastal.title: Summerland wildfire evacuee says overhaul of emergency support services needed
coastal.description: Dawne Young, a retired 911 dispatcher, said her evacuation experience was unsettling. Her neighbour's home was lost in the Bald Range wildfire. She said her family did not all receive the emergency alert, and she was met with lengthy delays trying to register as an evacuee.

coastal.title: Forestry giant behind idled B.C. mill received millions in government funding
coastal.description: A day after Canada's largest forestry company announced plans to shutter a pulp and paper mill on British Columbia's Sunshine Coast, the community is still reeling.

coastal.title: Langford tries new tool for mitigating wildfires: a herd of goats
coastal.description: A herd of 13 goats spent Friday clambering to munch on a thicket of blackberry bushes and brambles near the Starlight Stadium in Langford – part of a pilot program to prune the city's flammable underbrush and raise awareness of fire safety tools.

coastal.title: Following fire, Summerland orchards race to save fruit from spoilage
coastal.description: While Deep Brar’s property is physically undamaged by the flames, his business, Brarstar Orchards, has still incurred a significant cost — much of his fruit was left to rot on the trees during the evacuation.

kamloops.title: Fresh evacuations ordered south of Pear Lake wildfire in B.C. Interior
kamloops.description: Officials have expanded evacuation orders related to British Columbia's largest wildfire.
